from rle import encode, decode
# Test cases
tests = [
    ('aaabbc', 'a3b2c1'),
    ('a', 'a1'),
    ('', ''),
    ('abc', 'a1b1c1'),
    ('x'*12, 'x12'),
    ('aaabba', 'a3b2a1'),
]
for inp, expected in tests:
    out = encode(inp)
    assert out == expected, f"encode({inp!r}) = {out!r}, expected {expected!r}"
    # round-trip
    decoded = decode(out)
    assert decoded == inp, f"decode(encode({inp!r})) = {decoded!r}, expected {inp!r}"
print('All tests passed')
